0x01.description: Update PID gain (Kp/Ki/Kd) for one of 7 control axes.
0x01.name: PID_GAIN

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime; changes control response immediately.

0x02.description: Update MRAC adaptation gain gamma[axis][elem]. Positive values only.
0x02.name: MRAC_GAMMA

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime; changes adaptation rate.

0x03.description: Update mixer gain and saturation limits.
0x03.name: MIXER_SATURATION

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.

0x04.description: Abort all paths and recover SDK authority. DANGEROUS: idx=0 is an immediate stop.
0x04.name: FLIGHT_MODE_ABORT

safety_class.description: idx=0: abort all paths, zero sticks, dangerous stop. idx=1: recover SDK authority.

0x05.description: Update MRAC weight limit What_limit[axis][elem]. Non-negative.
0x05.name: MRAC_WEIGHT_LIMIT

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.

0x06.description: Inject virtual RC stick value. SDK mode only.
0x06.name: VIRTUAL_STICK

safety_class.description: SDK mode required. sbus_lost is not checked; RC is emergency fallback.

0x07.description: Enable/disable bench test mode (prop-wash safety gate).
0x07.name: BENCH_MODE

safety_class.description: Disables automatic FLYING transition. Throttle NOT capped.

0x08.description: Update MRAC weight tolerance What_tol[axis][elem]. Non-negative.
0x08.name: MRAC_TOLERANCE

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.

0x09.description: Set velocity and attitude safety limits from ground station.
0x09.name: SAFETY_LIMITS

safety_class.description: idx 0: horizontal speed m/s (0.05..20). idx 1: vertical speed m/s (0.05..10). idx 2: max pitch deg (3..60). idx 3: max roll deg (3..60).

0x0A.description: Set three-waypoint (TWC) target position. SDK mode only.
0x0A.name: TWC_TARGET

safety_class.description: Path following in SDK mode.

0x0B.description: Configure and activate sinusoidal reference path. SDK mode only.
0x0B.name: SINUSOID_PATH

safety_class.description: Sinusoidal path in SDK mode.

0x0C.description: Configure and activate circular reference path. SDK mode only.
0x0C.name: CIRCLE_PATH

safety_class.description: Circular path in SDK mode.

0x0D.description: Abort all active paths (TWC, sinusoid, circle, figure-8).
0x0D.name: ABORT_ALL_PATHS

safety_class.description: Stops all path following. Neutral sticks. Dangerous stop.

0x0F.description: Multiplexed command: MRAC flags (idx 0..12) or telemetry mode (idx 100..102).
0x0F.name: MULTIPLEX_FLAGS

safety_class.description: MRAC runtime flags: adaptation_on, output_injection_on, id_frame_on, of_frame_on. Telemetry mode switch: idx 100=LEGACY, 101=MIXED, 102=SUBSCRIBE_ONLY.

0x10.description: Reset world-frame optical flow origin to current location.
0x10.name: RESET_ORIGIN

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.

0x11.description: Configure and activate figure-8 (lemniscate) path. SDK mode only.
0x11.name: FIGURE8_PATH

safety_class.description: Figure-8 path in SDK mode.

0x12.description: Set waypoint density spacing (cm units from GUI).
0x12.name: WAYPOINT_SPACING

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.
Bumpless switch: reference states snap to plant on change.

0x14.description: Configure and start/stop system identification excitation.
0x14.name: SYSID_CONTROL

safety_class.description: System identification: chirp or multisine excitation.

0x15.description: Enable/disable gyro low-pass filter and set cutoff frequency.
0x15.name: GYRO_LPF

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.
Motor bench: disarmed only. Streams frame 0x04.

0x17.description: One-shot optical-flow velocity-bias capture. Pilot holds drone still ~2 s.
0x17.name: OF_BIAS_CAPTURE

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime. Averaged over ~2 s.

0x18.description: Force full recalibration (accel + gyro + EKF). Ground-idle + disarmed only.
0x18.name: FORCE_RECALIBRATE

safety_class.description: Re-enters cold-cal. Clears all bias and EKF state.

0x1E.description: OF bias estimation mode: FIXED=0, EMA=1, EKF=2. EMA freeze flag idx=1.
0x1E.name: OF_BIAS_MODE

safety_class.description: Safe at runtime.

GET./.well-known/agent-permissions.json: permission manifest for arriving agents (LAS-WG shape); generated from the live action registry + control state
GET./api/agent/actions: agent action registry {actions: [{name, risk, args_schema, description}]}
GET./api/agent/control: agent control state {mode, allow_agent_arm, tier0_access, changed_at, changed_by}
GET./api/agent/state: one agent-facing snapshot {control, ui, recording, layout, arm_state, stream_health, running_plan, pending_approvals, last_messages}
GET./api/agent/stream: server-sent events; the push channel (blocks, heartbeat comment every SSE_HEARTBEAT_S)
GET./api/debug/memory: tracemalloc snapshot, psutil stats, gc counts, top object types
GET./api/diagnostics/bundle: frames, commands, faults for bug reports
GET./api/manifest: full system capability manifest (symbols, commands, telemetry, panels, routes)
GET./api/preset-for-symbol: preset(s) whose slot manifest carries the symbol (item 14; ?symbol=<key>; read-only, computed from multi_slot_presets.yaml)
GET./api/recording: recording state {recording, session_dir, started_at, rows, bytes, reason}
GET./api/session/notes: operator notes buffered while not recording
GET./api/session/notes?since=<seq>: seq-tagged note log (new notes since seq)
GET./api/symbols: DWARF symbol names from the firmware ELF (?prefix=N&parent=P&limit=N; default/max limit 100/1000)
GET./api/view-model: browser-renderable state for agents; ?stats=1 adds session_stats (full-session scan, slow on long sessions)
GET./llms.txt: Markdown map of what an agent should read first (text/markdown)
GET./replay/<id>: stored records for replay (?limit=N&offset=N, default 1000, limit=0 = all)
GET./sessions/<id>/records: session telemetry records (?limit=N&offset=N, default 1000, limit=0 = all)

POST./api/agent/control: set control {mode?, allow_agent_arm?, tier0_access?: partial|full, source} (423 while off; 403 if an agent: source sets allow_agent_arm/tier0_access)
POST./api/agent/plans: submit a plan {title, goal?, source, steps}, ?queue:true to enqueue (201 / 409 / 400)
POST./api/agent/ui-ack: browser acks a ui_action {plan_id, step_id, ok, error?}
POST./api/agent/ui-state: browser shell reports UI state {active_tab, visible_panels, drawer_open, url}
POST./commands: send a command to the drone (arm-gated)
POST./replay/<id>/play: push stored telemetry onto the live bus; sends nothing to the drone
POST./subscribe: program subscribe slots on the drone
POST./subscribe/preview: validate a subscribe request, sends nothing

telemetry.derivation_note: Keys are derived from wifi_bridge.py frame decoders (_decode_frame_a, _decode_frame_b, _decode_frame_c, _decode_frame_id, _decode_mavlink_*, _slot0_to_sidebar) and boot_default_layout.py. Dynamic slot subscriptions (0x21 requests) publish variables prefixed with 'slot{N}.' using requested DWARF names or positional fallbacks 'ch{N}.{idx}'.

frame_a_raw_vars.description: Raw DWARF symbol paths emitted directly on slot 0

frame_a_sidebar.description: Attitude, MRAC error/adaptive-effort, battery, and status flags mapped from slot-0

frame_b.description: MRAC weights vector, PID loop (FB/Des/U) values, and path telemetry

frame_c.description: 50 Hz body rates, attitude, earth position, altitude, and motor RPMs

frame_id.description: 100 Hz counter and flight status flags

justfloat_fallback.description: 16-byte JustFloat attitude fallback when no stream is active

mavlink.description: MAVLink v1.0 custom message decoders (MRAC, EKF, Control debug)

subscribe_stream_metadata.description: Per-slot stream metadata embedded in JSON payload for each subscribe slot (0..3)
